title: No glucose values in G6 after calibrating: Confused Calibration 1
symptom: After calibrating a new G6 sensor, no glucose readings are received and the app shows 'Confused Calibration 1'. The event log is crowded with 'Encountered backfill data we don't recognize: 85 127'. The XDrip algorithm works but shows higher values than real ones.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A comment suggests that the transmitter will not accept huge calibration variances, implying that the calibration difference was too large, but this is not confirmed.
fix: A comment suggests recalibrating with the official Dexcom app, which may take multiple finger sticks and several hours, and then returning to xDrip with all automatic restarts disabled, especially preemptive restart with time travel. However, the user reports that the Dexcom app also failed to calibrate after waiting 11 hours, so this fix was not successful in the thread.
evidence_quote: Try recalibrating with the official Dexcom app. It will take multiple finger sticks and several hours, but that should reset the sensor. When you return to Xdrip disable all automatic restarts, especially preemptive restart with time travel. In essence the transmitter will not accept huge calibration variances.
